title: Origami
lyrics:
[00:11.75]Take a look at me
[00:14.69]Crumpled up on the floor feeling lonely
[00:20.23]Honestly, something is wrong with me
[00:26.53]I've been freaking out
[00:29.43]Folding myself into origami
[00:35.08]Terrified of what they would think of me
[00:42.73]I'll face the night deep in starlight
[00:50.61]Shadows unwind deep in starlight
[01:03.63]There's another way
[01:06.24]Apart from this misery and it's got me
[01:11.99]Wondering exactly what I'm missing
[01:18.38]Take a look at me
[01:21.16]Crumpled up on the floor feeling lonely
[01:26.80]Honestly, something is wrong with me
[01:34.83]I'll face the night deep in starlight
[01:42.47]Shadows unwind deep in starlight
[01:53.26]I'll face the night
